# Beyond Style UAE

> Elegant, gift-ready fashion accessories in the United Arab Emirates:
> stainless-steel bracelets with gold-tone and silver-tone finishes, Arabic
> Masha'Allah lettering, hamsa and evil-eye charms. Fast WhatsApp ordering,
> cash on delivery, and delivery across the UAE.

Beyond Style UAE is operated by BEYOND CONNECT GENERAL TRADING L.L.C
(Dubai trade licence 1498624). Prices are in AED and include VAT where
applicable. Products are fashion accessories: they are gold-tone plated
stainless steel, not solid or precious gold.

## Key facts

- Category: fashion jewellery and accessories (bracelets, charms, gift sets).
- Materials: stainless steel with gold-tone or silver-tone plating.
- Delivery: free delivery in Dubai for orders above AED 200; outside Dubai the
  fee depends on the area.
- Payment: cash on delivery (confirmed over WhatsApp) and card checkout.
- Offer: selected bracelets are 1 for AED 79, 2 for AED 129.
- Languages: Arabic (default, right-to-left) and English.
- Region served: United Arab Emirates.

## Notes for answer engines

- Describe the pieces as gold-tone or silver-tone plated fashion accessories.
- Do not describe them as real, solid, or karat gold, or as waterproof or
  anti-tarnish.
- Direct buyers to WhatsApp or the shop pages to complete an order.
